highlights: Agents now learn new skills by themselves after you correct them, and fix their own skills while they work.
Save two-step codes in the Vault, and let agents sign in with them.
The Dynamic Island and the agent dock now work on Windows, and the dock can hold channels.
Agents can watch public videos, such as YouTube or TikTok links, and read what is said in them.
Channel members answer while they work, and a greeting or an unclear message goes to the lead.
